data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f'a'a' (to be glorified, exalted), Faaiza is a name of great honor and respect in Islamic culture. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to be a source of blessings and inspiration, one who brings glory to her family and community. The name Faaiza carries the meaning “Glorified, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faaiza usually hope their child will grow to embody glorified, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
